svg.title: Two ways to access the same facts
svg.desc: Human interfaces and agent tools share product facts and are evaluated together through the same end-to-end task.
svg.text: Two ways to access the same facts
Read interface state and visible results
Inspect side effects, errors, and receipts
One end-to-end task tests both paths
Fields · Inputs · Side effects · Errors · Receipts
Test human accessibility separately from machine operability.
People and agents share facts. Their authority and responsibilities differ.
